headline: Google releases three new Gemini models — but no 3.5 Pro
snapshot: Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and Flash Cyber, but the continued absence of Gemini 3.5 Pro raises fresh questions about its AI strategy. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
